verse.verse_3: by the even and the odd,
verse.verse_5: is there not in this strong evidence for a man of sense?
verse.verse_6: Have you not heard of how your Lord dealt with the tribe of 'Ad,
verse.verse_7: the people of Iram, the city of many pillars,
verse.verse_8: the like of which has never been created in the land,
verse.verse_9: and with the Thamud, who cut out [huge] rocks in the valley,
verse.verse_10: and with Pharaoh of the stakes?
verse.verse_11: All of them committed excesses in their lands,
verse.verse_12: and caused much corruption in them:
verse.verse_13: so your Lord unleashed on them the scourge of punishment:
verse.verse_14: for, indeed, your Sustainer is ever on the watch!
verse.verse_15: As for man, when his Lord tests him, through honour and blessings, he says, "My Lord has honoured me,"
verse.verse_16: but when He tests him by straitening his means of livelihood, he says, "My Lord has disgraced me."
verse.verse_17: No indeed, but you show no kindness to the orphan,
verse.verse_18: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor,
verse.verse_19: and you greedily devour the inheritance of the weak,
verse.verse_20: and you have a love of wealth which can never be satisfied.
verse.verse_21: No indeed! When the earth is crushed and ground to dust,
verse.verse_22: when your Lord comes down with the angels, rank upon rank,
verse.verse_23: and Hell is made to appear on that Day, then man will be mindful, but what will being mindful then avail him?
verse.verse_24: He will say, "Oh, would that I had provided beforehand for my life!"
verse.verse_25: On that Day no one will punish as He punishes,
verse.verse_26: and none can bind with bonds like His!
verse.verse_27: [But to the righteous, God will say], "O soul at peace,
verse.verse_28: return to your Lord, well-pleased, well-pleasing.
